notes: "BPK-1006" is Riedel's Bolero 6-key wireless intercom beltpack, sold under regional SKUs BL-BPK-1006-19-US/EU/BR/etc. (the "19" denotes the 1.9GHz license-free DECT band; other suffixes denote frequency-band/region variants). Physical I/O is identical across regional variants; only RF band/certification differs. Rack units omitted — this is a wearable beltpack (86 x 48 x 130 mm, 420g), not rack-mountable. Category/type: no exact "wireless intercom beltpack" option exists in the provided type enum; "Other" was used rather than "Wireless mic" because this is a two-way full-duplex intercom transceiver (6 audio paths + walkie-talkie mode with built-in mic/speaker), not a one-way mic transmitter. Also has Bluetooth v4.1 (headset/phone audio) and NFC (beltpack registration) — not physical ports, omitted. IP-65 sealed when the XLR headset connector is plugged in. Spec table cross-verified against Riedel's official Bolero Intercom System User Manual (via ManualsLib), which independently confirms the 4-pin XLR headset jack, 3.5mm line-in jack, and USB port for charging/firmware.

ports.name: Headset
ports.note: Physically a 4-pin male XLR (mic -, mic + ~5VDC bias, earphone -, earphone +), user-replaceable. No dedicated 4-pin audio XLR id exists in the allowed connector list, so 'xlr3' (same family, audio use) was used as the closest match rather than 'xlr4-dc' (which denotes DC power wiring, not audio).

ports.name: Line In
ports.note: Local audio mix input only, 40 Hz-20 kHz, max +12 dBu input level.

ports.name: USB-C
ports.note: Used for beltpack battery charging (requires >500mA USB port) and firmware updates. No USB speed/version stated in specs, so grade omitted. Device is battery-powered (removable Li-ion pack); this is the only physical power input on the beltpack itself (a separate multi-bay charging dock accessory exists but is a different SKU, not covered here).
